extracted.intended_audience: policy researchers, journalists, legal practitioners, and stakeholders monitoring U.S. federal regulatory changes
extracted.subtask_description: A curated tracker and dataset that documents significant regulatory and deregulatory changes under the second Trump administration, providing status, background, impact, litigation, and metadata for each tracked entry. Designed for monitoring, analysis, and download (CSV).

rubrics_metrics.name: Curated selection of regulatory activity
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides background information and status updates on a curated selection of significant regulatory and deregulatory changes made by the Trump administration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The tracker monitors a curated selection of new, delayed, and repealed rules, notable guidance and policy revocations, executive actions, and important court battles across key policy areas such as environmental, health, labor, and more.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: Focus on major changes under the current administration
rubrics_metrics.description: The Reg Tracker focuses on major regulatory changes implemented under the current Trump administration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries tracked during the Biden administration and during President Trump’s first term are available through the 'Biden' or 'Trump Term 1' archive checkboxes; use the Include Archives filter to view them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter: Include Archives
rubrics_metrics.description: Allow inclusion of archived entries from other administrations (Trump Term 1, Biden).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables comparative or historical viewing by toggling access to past-administration entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter / Field: Name
rubrics_metrics.description: The title or name of the regulatory action or rule being tracked.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to identify and search for specific rules or actions in the tracker.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter / Field: Nature of Action
rubrics_metrics.description: The type or nature of the regulatory action (e.g., new rule, repeal, guidance revocation, executive action).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps differentiate kinds of regulatory activity and group similar actions together.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter / Field: Category(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy area(s) affected by the regulatory action (e.g., environmental, health, labor).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables filtering and aggregation by topical domain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter / Field: Agency(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: The federal agency or agencies responsible for the rule or action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for tracking activity by issuing body and assessing agency-level patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter / Field: Current Status
rubrics_metrics.description: The present procedural or legal status of the rule/action in the tracker.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See explicit status definitions (Rescinded; Delayed; In Rulemaking; In Effect; Unchanged; Partially Effective) for precise meaning of values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter / Field: Last Updated
rubrics_metrics.description: Date indicating when the tracker entry or the underlying rule information was last updated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to assess currency; the tracker notes rules are up to date as of March 30, 2026 and the tracker was last updated March 31, 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field: Background
rubrics_metrics.description: Background information about the rule, including context and history.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides narrative context to understand origins, prior versions, and reasons for regulatory change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field: Impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Description or assessment of the expected or observed impact of the rule/action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to highlight why an entry is significant and what consequences it may have across stakeholders or sectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field: Litigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on notable court battles, lawsuits, or legal challenges related to the rule/action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures ongoing or resolved litigation that affects the status or implementation of the rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field: Notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplementary notes or miscellaneous information about the entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Holds additional context, caveats, or links not captured in other structured fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status definition: Rescinded
rubrics_metrics.description: the rule has been repealed and rescinded, or withdrawn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the rule is no longer in force because it has been formally removed or withdrawn.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status definition: Delayed
rubrics_metrics.description: the rule has been delayed and is not in other stages of rulemaking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates implementation or effective dates have been postponed and the rule is not actively progressing through other rulemaking stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status definition: In Rulemaking
rubrics_metrics.description: the rule is currently progressing in some stage of the rulemaking process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers rules that are in NPRM, proposal, comment, finalization, or other active rulemaking steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status definition: In Effect
rubrics_metrics.description: the rule is in effect and in practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the rule has been finalized and is operative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status definition: Unchanged
rubrics_metrics.description: the original regulatory rule remains unchanged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used when the rule remains as previously promulgated with no implemented changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status definition: Partially Effective
rubrics_metrics.description: only part of the original rule is in effect, or some provisions are delayed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures hybrid states where certain provisions apply while others are stayed, delayed, or rescinded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data availability: CSV download
rubrics_metrics.description: A spreadsheet (CSV) of the tracker is available for download.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides machine-readable access to the tracker (link: Reg-Tracker-Spreadsheet-3.30.2026-v2.csv) for analysis, reuse, and verification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feedback / transparency contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact information for questions or suggestions about inclusion/exclusion and usability of the tracker.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users can email [email protected] with suggestions about what regulatory activity is or isn't included or feedback on usability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication independence statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Brookings Institution statement that each publication represents the sole views of its author(s) and notes funding diversity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals institutional commitments to quality and independence relevant to interpreting the tracker content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use guidance: interactive features and selection explanation (external)
rubrics_metrics.description: The page points to a more thorough explanation of how entries are selected, an overview of the rulemaking process, and guidance on using the Reg Tracker’s interactive features.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users are directed to 'click here' for detailed methodology and instructions; the main page references but does not reproduce that full guidance.
